If Sargon performs a Political action, when does he get the edge?
Before or after the referendum?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Jozxyqk wrote:
>
> If Sargon performs a Political action, when does he get the edge?

And you get it even if the referendum fails.

Messages.Author: Henrik
Messages.Body:
>>
>> If Sargon performs a Political action, when does he get the edge?
>> Before or after the referendum?
>
>After.
>And you get it even if the referendum fails.
>

If the vote is a regaining the upper hand, and sargon is nice enough to give
the edge to his prey (as there is a form of corruption in play), who get's
to keep the edge after the action is complete, and if it's Sargons
controller, did the preyt actually had time to "get" the edge, and thus get
a counter on the FoC?

/Henrik Isaksson

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


Yes. The effect of the referendum is applied (if it passed). After the resolution
of the action (whatever it was), Sargon's controller gets the Edge.



I wouldn't say that it's weak, if you are going to have the edge. Playing
my inferior presence deck, usually passing votes with just the edge and BO
is fine on the 1st-3rd turns. But after that any serious titles that appear
can devistate you. Any pre gain extra votes card is great. You need to use
it in addition. Now your inferior pre vampires can call a vote and have 6
votes in favor plus whatever they want to spend for an awe(or spend nothing
and have 7 votes)
